disclaimer: Study aid. Follow your vessel's fire plan and training.

cards.label: FIRE AT SEA
cards.title: Would your crew know what to do?

cards.label: ALARM
cards.title: Raise the alarm first.
cards.body: Shout "FIRE!" Tell the skipper where it is and what is burning.

cards.label: CONTAIN
cards.title: Close it up.
cards.body: Doors, hatches and vent fans. Fuel and power off.

cards.label: FIGHT
cards.title: Right extinguisher, at the base.
cards.body: Squeeze and sweep. Stay low, exit behind you.

cards.label: WATCH
cards.title: Out is not over.
cards.body: Keep a fire watch. Fires re-ignite.
